newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee takes out support, cocoa wanders.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee takes out support, cocoa wanders.

text.p: COFFEE - Opens down as expected, then carries on lower. Sept $60 lower at $1,675 at 0929 GMT, after breaking key $1,695 support.
COCOA - Opens higher, then falls back to near unchanged in light trade. Watches sterling/mark. Sept one stg higher at 1,034 stg.
SUGAR - Eases in light trade. August $40 cents down at $326.30.
